reload.label: F5 keeps the identity and the match
a second tab in the same browser is the same person
closing and reopening the page keeps the session
KNOWN LIMIT: opening /alpha after only READING the match through ?game= shows the entry screen (no resume yet)
entering the code with the same session returns to the same seat mid-match
after a request from the page, /alpha with no ?game= resumes the last match (localStorage)
leaving returns to the entry screen and clears ?game=
after leaving, a reload stays on the entry screen
leaving is client-only: the seat still exists on the server (documented behaviour)
entering the code again after leaving returns to the same seat mid-match
a browser without the session sees the entry screen, not the match
